What changed this round is the shape and value of the ground mark, not its schedule: the danger boundary is now the hammer's own 120-degree pie slice (straight edges out of the landing spot, hard far arc) instead of the arc inflated by the player radius, which rounded into a featureless dome; the inflated graze boundary is kept as a thin dotted line outside the cone.
